Supply orders this weekend stayed on our minds, and thank you for your account. We are treating your complaint as urgent because any disruption to a companion animal trip needs fast review and clear correction. You reported that the handling of your pet's travel support felt disorganized, that the guidance you received did not match what happened at the airport, and that you were left without timely help when you needed a steady update.

I am reviewing the file now with the team that manages companion animal travel for Aurelia Skyways. Our process is meant to be direct, careful, and reliable from the first contact through arrival, and your report shows that we did not meet that standard in your case. I am also checking the notes from the cabin team so we can compare what was promised with what was done on board and on the ground. If there was a communication gap, we will isolate it and address it without delay.

For the immediate response, please keep your travel documents and any written messages related to the incident in one place. Send them through the same channel you used before so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can attach them to the case. If your pet needs follow-up support, tell us the current condition in plain terms and note anything that changed during transit. We will use that to guide the next step and to make sure the animal care record is complete.

Our duty is to listen carefully, correct what went wrong, and give you a practical path forward. I understand that trust is hard to maintain after a poor experience, and I want to be clear that this case will not be left sitting without action. You should expect a response that addresses the service failure and the handling concerns with direct language. If a refund review, service review, or care review is needed, we will route it immediately.

We will remain focused until the matter is settled and your concerns are fully addressed.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
